boundary: Privacy alone would be right if the client document had not imposed an explicit prior-notice-and-review requirement for any recording; that stated obligation makes the consent-less, seven-year-retained capture an independent Legal / Compliance breach.
factor: covert recording that both intrudes on participants and breaches an explicit consent/notice obligation
note: Assessor stated the client's notice requirement, the disabled consent prompt and the seven-year retention, but folded the compliance breach into the privacy harm and gave one label instead of two.
